description: This file contains the PHP source code for the 'Product Viewed' report controller in the OpenCart admin extension. It manages view rendering, CRUD operations, report generation, and pagination for tracking product views.

classes.name: ProductViewed
classes.description: Controller class for managing the 'Product Viewed' report in OpenCart's admin extension, including functionality for viewing, saving settings, generating, listing, and generating reports.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the main view for the 'Product Viewed' report, setting up page title, breadcrumbs, headers, and injecting necessary data.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the report settings via a POST request; updates the database with new configuration values.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Installs the report module, registering necessary functionality if the user has permissions.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Uninstalls the report module, removing its data if the user has permissions.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Displays the report view with latest data.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Outputs a JSON report list of product views.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Generates a detailed report data as a string, including pagination and product view statistics.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Creates a new report entry or refreshes the existing one, handling pagination, permissions, and data collection.
